newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul Jan-April overseas building orders up 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Seoul Jan-April overseas building orders up 18 pct.

text.p: Overseas orders received by South Korean contractors totalled $4.39 billion during the first four months of this year, up from $3.72 billion a year earlier, the Ministry of Construction and Transportation said on Friday.
Orders won in Asian countries other than the Middle East rose to $3.55 billion from $2.75 billion, the ministry said.
Orders from the Middle East fell to $216 million in January-April from $317 million in the same period a year before.
Orders received from Indonesia amounted to $925 million, accounting for 21 percent of the total.
Orders from China were valued at $862 million in the four-month period, the ministry said.

By company, Hyundai Enginnering and Construction Co Ltd won orders of $1.14 billion in the period, followed by Daewoo Corp with $828 million and Ssangyong Engineering and Construction Co Ltd with $569 million, the ministry said.
South Korean contractors won $10.78 billion worth of orders from abroad in 1996, up from $8.51 billion in 1995.
